extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density tolerance from a workflow config dictionary
filter_single_structure_dataset: filter and deduplicate a single parquet dataset of ML-relaxed crystal structures by energy, density, and connectivity
orchestrate_parallel_filtering: submit parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate multiple crystal structure datasets across a directory
validate_connectivity_preservation: validate that covalent bonding networks are preserved during ML relaxation by comparing unrelaxed and relaxed CIF structures
deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate crystal structures using pymatgen StructureMatcher with configurable lattice, site, and angle tolerances
